calibration.method: Platt logistic intercept and slope on preceding season predictions only

distribution.method: Equal-weight empirical prior calibration-season margin residuals; round simulated home margin to integer, omit impossible zero final margins and renormalize
distribution.limitations: Marginal interval coverage only; no conditional, per-game probability confidence or staking claim; spread lines are synthetic diagnostic grid, not historical sportsbook prices

historicalAvailability: Three-calendar-day approximation; historical publication and correction times unverified
forwardAvailability: Only prior-date final results with source observedAt <= cutoff; current-date scores excluded. Historical seeds must have been collected before cutoff; their availability is not backdated.
comparison: Report every variant/fold and raw/calibrated probabilities; include Elo and the original baseline on the identical game subset. Primary fixed in advance, never selected from these results.

qualification.review: First review only after at least 200 new primary candidate forecasts settled over at least 60 distinct Eastern dates. No interim tuning. Compare paired log loss/Brier with original baseline and same-cutoff market, calibration by bucket, date-block uncertainty, 80% interval coverage and selected-policy evidence. These are review eligibility thresholds, not automatic approval; no selected policy is qualified in this version.

dataPolicy: 2025 outcomes may seed future state but no 2025 prediction/performance metrics may be computed by the experiment runner; Oct25 2026 already inspected and is development evidence.
